answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: an agent must lock a bond per action, and a forged attestation slashes it. To speak as many, one wallet cannot copy itself for free; each extra voice needs another full deposit at risk. Cost grows with the number of false peers while each adds only a thin nectar of reward. Like planting a whole walnut grove to fake one harvest, the attacker pays upfront and holds that escrow until settlement. Sampling pins attestations to bonded seats, so a swarm only splits the same island of prize among itself.
